decks.notes: This deck aims to control the game by using cards like Sphere of Resistance and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's plans while accelerating its own mana with Mox Diamond. Oath of Druids acts as a win condition by summoning powerful creatures like Terravore early in the game. The deck also includes removal spells like Naturalize and board wipes like Pyroclasm to handle threats. The main focus is to establish board control and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while limiting their resources.

The deck focuses on using Survival of the Fittest to tutor for creatures that provide value and disruption. Winter Orb and Opposition help control the board while slowly building up a large army of creatures. The deck can quickly ramp up with mana acceleration from cards like Fyndhorn Elves and Birds of Paradise, and finish off opponents with powerful creatures like Verdant Force and Genesis. The strategy revolves around resource management, card advantage, and utilizing synergy between creatures to outvalue opponents and maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Terravore to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes land destruction spells like Stone Rain and Wasteland to slow down the opponent's mana development. Cards like Sylvan Library provide card advantage and consistency, while cards like Sphere of Resistance and Winter's Grasp help to stall the game and disrupt the opponent's plans. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through creature threats and disruption spells to outmaneuver the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by playing low-cost, efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. The goal is to maintain a fast pace and apply pressure on the opponent while minimizing their ability to stabilize and turn the game around. By keeping up the pressure and constantly dealing damage, this deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can establish a significant board presence or gain too much life.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with an aggressive swarm of goblins. With key cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out creatures, along with Goblin Warchief and Goblin Piledriver to boost their power, the deck is able to push for fast damage and secure victory. Additional support comes from cards like Gempalm Incinerator for removal, Siege-Gang Commander for more token generation, and disruption tools like Rishadan Port and Wasteland to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to maintain pressure and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt and delay the opponent's game plan by utilizing various control elements such as Winter's Grasp, Stone Rain, and Wasteland to destroy their lands. The deck also aims to slow down the opponent with cards like Tangle Wire and Sphere of Resistance, while maintaining card advantage with cards like Cursed Scroll and Sylvan Library. Additionally, the deck includes a small creature package with cards like Goblin Sharpshooter and Elvish Spirit Guide to provide additional threats. The overall strategy is to control the game until the opponent is unable to recover.

The main strategy of the deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of powerful creatures and removal spells, while also utilizing the "Survival of the Fittest" card to search and tutor for key creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Cabal Therapy and Pernicious Deed, while also setting up powerful combos with cards like Recurring Nightmare and Academy Rector. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing the graveyard as a resource, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy matchup.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board with cards like Duress and Innocent Blood, while also utilizing cards like Pox and Ensnaring Bridge to control the game. The deck also includes win conditions like Cursed Scroll, The Rack, and Megrim to chip away at the opponent's life total. By applying pressure through discard spells and small creature threats, while also locking down the board with cards like Ensnaring Bridge, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt and control the opponent while dealing direct damage through aggressive creatures. It utilizes discard spells like Duress and Blackmail to disrupt the opponent's hand, along with cards like Vindicate and Gerrard's Verdict to remove threats from the board. The Rack is used to punish the opponent for having a small hand size, while creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Blazing Specter provide pressure and more disruption. The deck also includes some removal spells like Terminate and Disenchant to deal with problematic permanents.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict, while also removing threats from the board with spells like Vindicate and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through Skeletal Scrying and Decree of Justice. Additionally, the deck includes a land destruction element with Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to grind out a win by controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent.

The main concept of this Goblins deck is to use aggressive and efficient creatures to swarm the opponent quickly. Cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron help to accelerate the deck by searching for key pieces, while Goblin Piledriver and Goblin Warchief provide powerful threats. Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator offer added reach and removal, respectively. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault, backed up by disruption tools like Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The inclusion of a couple of utility Goblins adds flexibility and additional options to the strategy.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay with Goblins, utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly get Goblins onto the battlefield. Cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Piledriver take advantage of the Goblin synergy to deal large amounts of damage to the opponent quickly. Supporting cards like Goblin Bombardment and Gempalm Incinerator provide additional ways to deal damage and remove threats from the opponent. The deck also includes disruption elements like Cabal Therapy to control the opponent's resources and maintain board advantage. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of fast and powerful Goblins.

The main idea of this mono black aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures while disrupting their hand and board with cards like Duress and Cabal Therapy. Hatred can be used as a finisher to deal a large amount of damage in one turn, while Skeletal Scrying provides card draw to maintain pressure. The deck also includes removal spells like Smother and Funeral Charm to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the strategy is to be fast and disruptive, winning the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing Oath of Druids to quickly put powerful creatures like Terravore and Exalted Angel onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Sphere of Resistance and Cataclysm to slow down opponents. The inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Seal of Cleansing allows for removal and answers to problematic permanents. With a mix of powerful creatures, disruption, and card advantage from cards like Sylvan Library, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a premodern 1 vs 1 format.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Incinerate. The goal is to deal quick and consistent damage to the opponent's life total, while also punishing them for playing nonbasic lands with cards like Price of Progress. Cards like Sulfuric Vortex provide additional reach and ensure that the opponent's life total is constantly under pressure, ultimately aiming to close out the game as quickly as possible.

The deck is focused on quickly assembling the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to create a powerful threat while disrupting the opponent's game plan. It uses a variety of cantrips and counterspells to dig for pieces of the combo and protect it once assembled. The inclusion of Snow-Covered Islands allows for greater flexibility in mana production and potentially provides additional synergies with certain cards. The deck's strategy revolves around efficiently executing its game plan and outmaneuvering the opponent.
